messages:
Maya R: Quick sync — we just got a marketplace intake for Acme Corp that lists GreyRock as the SI and also references TitanHW as preferred hardware partner. Both teams claim coverage for this account. How are we routing co-sell leads when SI + HW overlap?
AJ: Woof, this pops up a lot. current rule (old): first-claim wins unless AM escalates. But that breaks marketplace deals where HW brings infra discounts.
Carl S: For dedicated/private deals we usually favor HW if there's a discount attach, otherwise SI gets routing for implementation. But marketplace flows need stricter rules.
Jess (GreyRock): FYI GreyRock has an MSA + logo match for Acme — we logged a channel intro last quarter. We also run a joint PoC with Titan for storage. We should be able to own co-sell.
Maya R: Can we codify a short OR-case for marketplace intake? Proposal: 1) check existing logged PSR / MSA match -> award to SI; 2) if HW has active reseller discount > X% and is primary procurement route -> award to HW; 3) if both true -> require AM + Partnerships tie-breaker. Thoughts?
AJ: 👍 on the flow. What's X? 10% ? 15%?
Carl S: 12% feels arbitrary. Maybe define X per region/hardware type. For now set 12% as temporary threshold until finance weighs in.
Jess (GreyRock): OK with the tie-breaker path but we need SLA on decision time. SI can't wait weeks. Suggest 48h SLA for Partnerships to resolve routing.
Maya R: 48h SLA accepted. I'll add a new intake flag: `procurement_channel` = [marketplace, direct, hw-reseller]. Also add `attached_discount_pct`.
Maya R: Example intake snippet we can add to the intake UI:
```
procurement_channel: marketplace
attached_discount_pct: 12
si_claimed: GreyRock
hw_partner: TitanHW
existing_msa: true
```
AJ: Nice. Who's owner of the 'tie-breaker' decision? Partnerships + Sales AE? We need authoritative person.
Maya R: Partnerships will own orchestration, Sales AE will ratify. If disagreement then escalate to Sales lead + Head of Partnerships.
MarketplaceBot: Note: marketplace listing 84412 references TitanHW as preferred infra. (link: https://marketplace.example.com/listings/84412)
Carl S: Action items: 1) Maya — add fields to intake UI + create triage checklist (48h SLA) 2) AJ — notify AE for Acme and ask them to confirm procurement path 3) Jess — provide MSA doc link to Partnerships channel.
Jess (GreyRock): Uploading MSA now -> https://files.redwood/greyrock/acme_msa_v2.pdf
AJ: I'll ping the AE and loop legal if needed.
Maya R: I'll draft the short routing doc and post in partnerships/general for a final signoff. Once approved we'll update the marketplace intake automation to enforce the 48h timer.
Jess (GreyRock): Appreciate it. One more ask — if SI wins routing, can we still surface TitanHW as preferred hardware for procurement discounts? That helps close.
Maya R: Yes — routing != procurement restrictions. We'll add a `preferred_hw` attribute that can be surfaced in the sales packet.
AJ: Great, closing the loop.
Maya R: Thanks team :rocket: — will follow up with PR to intake UI by EOD tomorrow.
